name: pianio
description: Free, open-source piano learning platform with Web MIDI, sheet music rendering, and 80 courses

scripts.build: pnpm generate:content && pnpm --filter @pianio/web build && node scripts/prepare-site.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @pianio/midi-web test && pnpm --filter @pianio/core-engine test && pnpm test:playback
